Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single isolated transparent PNG mine lift cage frame for the existing Aliens Tantalus Sea of Sorrows side-view game, front elevation.
Input images 1 and 2 are material and mechanical design references only: use their scratched gray steel, faded olive machine paint, exposed bolts, sturdy industrial construction and realistic hand-painted 3D sprite rendering. Do not copy their winch drum or make another winch. This is a companion mine lift cage assembly, an original project adaptation.
Subject: the complete empty rectangular steel cage of an industrial mine hoist, a tall person-height entrance with two robust side posts, overhead crossbeam with two small cable attachment rollers, and a shallow grated floor threshold. Keep the complete assembly inside the image with a small transparent margin. Front-facing orthographic elevation, symmetric left and right posts, no perspective angle. The height should be approximately 1.45 times the full outside width.
The central entrance must be entirely open and genuinely transparent: no back panel, no rear wall, no lattice or bars crossing the middle opening. Narrow retracted safety gate bars may be packed at the extreme sides next to the side posts. The floor is only a thin horizontal threshold; no deep perspective floor. The game will supply background, gate status and mechanics independently. No external walls, no shaft, no controls panel, no labels, no text, no people, no logos, no smoke or glow, no ground shadows, no watermark. Isolate the frame and its side details on true transparent alpha, including the entire central opening.
requests.revisionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target, this single front-facing empty mine lift cage frame. Correct only the two rope cables that currently extend out of the upper edge and are cut off. Remove both rope extensions above the pulley housings so the existing two pulley housings are the topmost parts of the assembly. Keep the little cable loops inside their housings, but no cable extends above the housings. Add a small completely transparent margin above both housings so every part of the object is visibly inside the canvas. Keep the entire cage, proportions, side posts, empty transparent central aperture, floor threshold, bolts, materials, colors, light and straight orthographic camera unchanged. Genuine transparent alpha background outside and through the entire empty central opening. No other changes, no text or extra objects.
requests.nativeProportionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target, the front-facing empty steel mine lift cage frame. Make one geometric correction for its existing game's actual doorway: widen and shorten the frame so its OPEN INNER APERTURE is nearly SQUARE, as wide as it is tall. This means moving the side posts farther apart, extending the overhead crossbeam and floor threshold horizontally, and shortening the long vertical side posts. Keep the posts, crossbeam and threshold sensible structural thickness; do not simply stretch the whole rendered picture. Rebuild their metal surfaces and bolts coherently at the changed lengths. The entire outside frame should have approximately equal total width and total height, with the two small roller housings slightly above the top beam.
Preserve every other design choice: front-facing orthographic elevation, bilateral symmetry, scratched gray steel and olive paint, two complete top pulley housings with no projecting cables, narrow retracted gate bars packed against the inner side posts, thin grated floor threshold, exact material style, colors and lighting. Central opening remains wholly transparent with no back wall or gate bars across it. Show the full object with a transparent margin on every side; do not crop the roller housings or feet. No new props, labels, controls, scene, text or ground shadows. Genuine transparent alpha outside and throughout the open inner aperture.

Detailed restrained painterly realism, weathered utilitarian survival-horror game-art finish, desaturated brown-gray/green palette, soft upper-left neutral light, consistent subtle relief. Entire patch visible with generous transparent margins, broad horizontal composition, about three times as wide as tall. Outer edge naturally breaks into scattered grains and fades to real alpha so patches can blend over a native floor. Do not create a rectangular texture card. True transparent background, no floor beyond the patch, no cast shadow outside it, no skyline, no people, no machinery, no symbols, no words, no title, no watermark. This is a decorative ground material, not a map or a canonical geology claim.

Keep its worn olive-gray metal, ochre hazard striping, upper carrying handle, perforated heat shield, muzzle, dark main pistol grip and forward support grip, painterly realistic rendering and exact right-facing orthogonal side view. Change only the excessively long rear assembly: make the rear casing, fuel-canister rear section and buttstock much shorter so the main grip is close to the rear end. The new short buttstock must end near the trigger-grip rear instead of projecting far behind the character when held. Preserve the front barrel/heat shield/muzzle design and two grips. This is visual game art, not a working design. True transparent background, preserve clean alpha. Do not create a sheet or multiple views. This is an original project adaptation with no claim of an authenticated novel weapon model.
